mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS collegeId, c.name AS collegeName, u.name AS teacherName, t.isbn AS isbn, t.title AS title, i.quantity AS quantity FROM order_form f JOIN order_form_item i ON i.form_id = f.id AND i.deleted = 0 JOIN textbook t ON t.id = i.textbook_id AND t.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.teacher_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_semester_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.semester_id = f.semester_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN college c ON c.id = p.college_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE f.status = 'reviewed' AND f.semester_id = #{semesterId} AND f.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.id, u.name, t.isbn
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_form f JOIN order_form_item i ON i.form_id = f.id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE f.status = 'reviewed' AND f.semester_id = #{semesterId} AND f.deleted = 0
